stories.title: Forecast: Rain moving away, but chilly weather remains
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: Austin's airport among those impacted by Friday's nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: A nationwide ground stop was issued by the FAA on Friday, affecting airports across the country including in Austin. The ground stop was later lifted Friday evening.

stories.title: Ground delay issued at Austin airport Sunday due to runway construction
stories.summary: The delay comes as AUS, like dozens of other airports across the country, is working to rectify issues caused by a nationwide ground stop that was issued on Friday.

stories.title: 2 charged with cruelty after 49 dogs, cats found in poor conditions in Upshur County
stories.summary: Terri and Timothy Hunter face multiple animal cruelty charges after 49 dogs and cats were found in poor conditions during an eviction, officials say.

stories.title: Where is Bob? Injured buck’s disappearance prompts Selma resident’s call for action
stories.summary: Linda Weniger says a familiar 10-point buck disappeared after suffering an arrow wound. She wants neighbors to seek no-hunting signs.

stories.title: Travel disruptions linger in Austin a day after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Austin travelers faced cancellations, delays and misplaced luggage, disrupting their plans on Saturday.

stories.title: Paws, jerseys and a world record: 1,020 dogs suit up for a cause in Austin
stories.summary: The Mighty Texas Dog Walk fetched its 15th world record, organizers say, while raising more than $120,000 to turn shelter pups into service dogs.

stories.title: From $30 billion to $50 billion: Duffy raises stakes after nationwide FAA disruption
stories.summary: "How long are we going to wait, America?" said Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy.

stories.title: H-E-B hands out $1 million in surprise gift cards to Texas shoppers
stories.summary: The surprise $100 gift cards kick off two months of holiday Meal Deals, seasonal coupons, and community Feast of Sharing dinners.

stories.title: Newly elected congressional representatives from South Texas join early push to ban House members from trading stocks
stories.summary: South Texas Democrats Katy Padilla Stout, Johnny Garcia and Bobby Pulido are part of the push to change U.S. House rules and ban members from trading stocks.

stories.title: Gator-aid not needed! A reported sick alligator in Sugar Land turns out to be something a little different
stories.summary: A call about a sick alligator in Sugar Land had an animal services officer preparing for a troubling encounter. Turns out, this gator was full of hot air.

stories.title: Former 'Lone Star Law' game warden pleads guilty to fraud-related charge in Jefferson County
stories.summary: Former "Lone Star Law" warden Justin Eddins pleaded guilty to making false statements to obtain credit, with a plea deal for probation and no restitution.
